body: The approximation tube and contrasts are structural promises, not finite-data membership certificates. The bound is uniform in future memory while axes stay in the same persistent tube; arbitrary drift is excluded. It does not reconstruct a full encoding, supply a gauge spectral floor, establish redundant-code recovery or turn operator proximity into a local-stochastic threshold.
